metadata.title: Blowdowns along Ricci flow in dimension four
metadata.abstract: We show that the blowdown shrinking Ricci soliton of Feldman, Ilmanen and Knopf is strictly dynamically stable in the following strong local sense: (1) The Ricci flow from every metric on a closed 4-manifold containing a region close to a rescaling of a sufficiently large compact subset of the soliton in either orientation and with controlled geometry elsewhere develops a singularity with unique tangent flow modeled on the soliton. (2) The singular time slice has an isolated conical singularity, and by Gianniotis-Schulze the flow can be continued by blowing down a sphere of self-intersection $\pm1$. (3) On a closed 4-manifold, the set of metrics whose Ricci flows have their first singularity modeled on the soliton is $C^{14}$-open. It is nonempty if and only if the manifold contains a sphere of self-intersection $\pm1$. (4) The soliton is strongly rigid among shrinking Ricci solitons. As applications, we construct $C^{14}$-open sets of initial data whose Ricci flows perform any prescribed ordered sequence of blowdowns. (1) Every closed simply connected smooth 4-manifold, including spin and exotic examples, can be reached by Ricci flow from a standard $k\mathbb{CP}^2\#\ell\overline{\mathbb{CP}}{}^2$, through finitely many blowdown singularities. (2) On the standard $2\mathbb{CP}^{2}\#9\overline{\mathbb{CP}}{}^{2}$, there are infinitely many open sets of initial metrics whose Ricci flows, after a single blowdown, reach pairwise nondiffeomorphic manifolds. The proof uses the spectral analysis of Naff and the second author and deals with the gauge-fixing problem along Ricci flow through a Ważewski argument inspired by Stolarski. We also use Bamler-Lai's PDE-ODI principle. Except for continuation (requiring nonnegative curvature of the asymptotic cone), all results apply to linearly stable nonflat asymptotically conical shrinkers in all dimensions.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: Ricci流blowdown的稳定性与拓扑应用
analysis.workSummary: 作者研究四维Feldman–Ilmanen–Knopf吹降收缩孤立子的强局部动力稳定性：闭流形在足够大紧区域经缩放后C¹³接近该模型、且外区满足指定尺度的曲率上界与体积下界时，Ricci流形成该模型的唯一切流及孤立锥形奇点。借助Gianniotis–Schulze延拓，可通过吹降自交数±1的球面继续流，并构造按指定顺序吹降的初始度量族。
techniques: 利用孤立子的谱分析，以Ważewski箱论证调节微分同胚和尺度
结合调和映射热流规范、Ricci–DeTurck方程与PDE–ODI原理
以锥形渐近与已有expander粘合延拓实现四维拓扑吹降
analysis.breakthrough: 将FIK线性稳定性提升为局部模型必然触发的动力稳定性和强刚性，并用开放初值族实现预定吹降顺序。拓扑推论允许从标准CP²与反向CP²的连通和，经有限次此类奇点延拓到任意闭单连通光滑四维流形，包括异质光滑结构。
analysis.limitations: 必须保留大紧区域贴近及外区几何控制；Corollary1.4的C¹⁴开放性陈述还明确排除secondary curvature blowup。唯一切流不同于穿越奇点的延拓唯一性，后者在本文仍是Conjecture1.6。推广到其他线性稳定AC收缩子时，延拓还需渐近锥的非负曲率条件。已读第1–7页主结果和路线，未独立验证谱输入、规范构造及整套48页证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确LLM只用于项目最后阶段校对，包括核查常数依赖、纠正少量数学与语法笔误。仅支持写作和有限论证核查，不支持核心动态稳定策略或证明由AI提出。
